about: Cases for scripts/eval_arms.ts. Written by the Tripwire team from the stated policy before any model run, not taken from any arm's output. Only clear-cut cases carry an expected label; every case is also scored on properties any good decision needs (valid, grounded numbers, valid tripwires, stale sources named, escalation where policy requires a human). Scenario cases apply the listed rows on top of the bundled data; synthetic rows say so.
